title: 50agents vs Softr: apps for your team or clients | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Softr: both build apps for your team or people outside it, on your own domain. Softr adds a visual editor; 50agents has AI agents run the app.
answer: Pick Softr for portals and internal tools you shape in a visual editor.
Pick 50agents for apps from plain words, for your team or clients on your own domain, with AI agents inside.
line: Apps from plain words, for your team or clients on your own domain.
ask: Keep track of customer requests and draft the replies
lede: Two app builders, for your team or your clients, row by row.

faqs.q: Can I build a client portal with 50agents?
faqs.a: Yes. A 50agents app can serve people outside your team, such as clients, on your own domain. Softr builds portals on a custom domain too.

faqs.q: Do both build apps from a prompt?
faqs.a: Yes. Softr has the AI Co-Builder, and in 50agents you tell Captain what you need.
Softr has a visual editor beside its AI builder. In 50agents you see every step and change it by asking Captain.

faqs.q: Can I move my Softr data over?
faqs.a: Softr table data downloads as CSV or XLSX. In 50agents, drop a CSV or Excel file into an app and Captain matches the columns.
Yes. An app keeps its records in 50agents, and you can import and export CSV. Softr has Softr Databases.
Softr builds client portals and internal tools. 50agents apps run on lists, boards and tables, with AI agents working the records.
